description: Add stage tracking and narrow loop guards for transform-before-place ALFWorld tasks.

actions.code:
def hook(ctx, nb):
    nb['stage'] = 'find_target'
    nb['last_hint'] = ''
    nb['transformed'] = False
    nb['placed_count'] = 0
    text = 'Follow ALFWorld order: find and take the target, do any required clean/heat/cool while carrying it, then put it at the destination. For two-object tasks, leave placed items and fetch another target.'
    return {'skills': [{'text': text}], 'tool_hint': 'Do not place before the required transform; do not take back an item already placed at the destination.'}
